options.message: Listen, I need help. There’s something seriously wrong, and I need to do something. But...I don’t know who to trust. Make it to Wave 40 without the base taking a single hit and then we can chat.
Okay, it looks like you are a fighter and I could use you.
Well, first things first. My name isn’t Dr. Synapse. My name is Dr. Aventon.
When we…landed here, I had to go undercover. After what happened to the ship, I knew the NSC would come after for me for the damages.
My ship, the Alphastar? It crash landed here. The plants on our ship started becoming sentient and evil when I began watering them with Chemical Supreme.
I’m not proud of it, but I made a side deal because NSC doesn’t pay the best. I was given orders to water those plants with Chemical Supreme and make it look like it was my idea.
Yes. And Turtlestone wouldn’t have asked me to do that unless she knew what it would do…to all of us. I bet she doesn’t know I’m alive.

I need to repair the ship and head home. Some questions need to be answered like how Turtlestone new plants would behave that way under Chemical Supreme. And why she wanted the Alphastar and my crew gone.
I could use your help if you wouldn’t mind. It’s not going to be easy to get justice for what happened.
Thanks for helping in the fight.
